exposure: polymorphism rs2165241 of the lysyl oxidase-like 1 (Loxl1) gene
cohort: 836 postmenopausal women in Brazil: 426 with pelvic organ prolapse (stages III and IV) and 410 controls (stages 0 and I)
finding: No association was found between the rs2165241 polymorphism of the Loxl1 gene and pelvic organ prolapse in Brazilian women.
mod_finding: Multiple cesarean sections (two or more) were found to be protective against pelvic organ prolapse.
